text: The selected LSOA has a GeoSensitivity of -1.513, ranked 14th of 168, indicating moderate but comparative geographic influence. It is part of a local high–high spatial cluster with a Local Moran I of 0.302 (p = 0.024), though pattern scale is not established. The latitude effect is -0.043 and longitude effect 0.320, both distinct from GeoSensitivity. Explanation stability and Geo branch fidelity are high.
